name: lore-forge
description: Local-first desktop app for writing game worlds, lore and characters, with a consistency checker.

scripts.typecheck: tsc -b packages/core packages/pdf packages/cli && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && npm run typecheck -w @lore-forge/desktop
scripts.dist:win: npm run build && npm run dist:win -w @lore-forge/desktop
scripts.dist:linux: npm run build && npm run dist:linux -w @lore-forge/desktop
